work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CLVIII (protocol LF36168 followed by the address Ad capitulum Coloniense LF36169) rebukes the Cologne chapter for accusing its archbishop and praises him; LF36194 → LF36203 across own provenance LF36197 (Roskovány) and page number 246 LF36200; complete 26 December 1837 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF36168–36168; the source closing at LF36231–36234 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima sexta decembris millesimo octingentesimo,_trigesimo septimo, pontificatus Nostri anno septimo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
